description: PowerModelsRestoration.jl, published by lanl-ansi, extends PowerModels with restoration ordering, minimum restoration sets, redispatch and maximum-load-delivery problems under severe network damage. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Catalogue records for comparison are model-powermodels-jl. Compatibility with these records has not been assumed.
